reviews.body:
Review baseline: `69ae39dc5b97e47a399ed6c42d841d421e29c6dd...b2e645ea42024ca1f583f52debbe57244af1080f`

**[P1] Use Cargo's worker artifact in raw-CLI tests**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/tests/support/ui_approval_slice.rs:1906` guesses that the
worker is available as `target/debug/cosh-ui-worker`. The integration gate only invokes
`cargo test -p cosh-shell --test raw_cli`, which does not materialize that un-hashed path.
The current run consequently reports zero workers or `ENOENT` in 18 tests, so none of the
new PTY scenarios exercises the worker path. Possible direction: use
`env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_cosh-ui-worker")` (or explicitly build the binary in the gate), and
assert that the selected artifact exists before starting the shell.

**[P1] Make the isolated worker start on the supported CI host**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/src/runtime/ui_coordinator/process.rs:128` is the common
pre-exec boundary for every fixture-backed coordinator test. In the current fast gate,
31 new tests exhaust their failure budget in `Unavailable` before reaching `Ready`, while
the same filtered module passes locally. This leaves the required lifecycle unvalidated
and keeps the mandatory fast gate red. Please preserve the underlying spawn/pre-exec
error in the test diagnostics and make this isolation path compatible with the CI host;
the canonical `scripts/run-test-gates.sh fast` invocation should be the regression test.

**[P2] Keep the viewport test independent of `TERM`**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/src/approval/slice_tests.rs:807` assumes the rebuilt card
starts with a box border. `RatatuiInlineRenderer::for_terminal()` legitimately selects
plain rendering when `TERM=dumb`, so the added test fails there and passes with
`TERM=xterm`. Please assert the width contract in both renderer modes, or inject a fixed
renderer without mutating process-global environment.

**[P2] Preserve the package's default runnable binary**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/Cargo.toml:16` adds a second binary without setting
`default-run`. As a result, the README's existing `cargo run --package cosh-shell -- raw`
commands now fail before launching because Cargo cannot choose a binary. Please set
`default-run = "cosh-shell"` or update every supported invocation, with a regression check
that executes the documented command shape.

**[P2] Localize the complete Chinese approval card**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/src/ui/approval_surface.rs:71` localizes only action labels;
the title, risk suffix, `Risk:` label, and irrecoverable warning remain hard-coded English.
A Chinese session therefore renders a mixed-language security prompt. Please project
closed translations for all static labels and add a render-level Chinese assertion; the
current test only checks that `UiLanguage::Zh` was selected.

Review baseline: `69ae39dc5b97e47a399ed6c42d841d421e29c6dd...37e025ef98fdd3ef98465a7ac47cfed2f9cae41d`

**[P1] Support isolation on the repository's CI host**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/src/runtime/ui_coordinator/process.rs:135` unconditionally
requires `close_range(..., CLOSE_RANGE_CLOEXEC)`. On the current runner that call returns
`EINVAL`; this head consequently fails 31 coordinator tests and 17 UI integration scenarios,
and the worker never reaches its first instruction. The diagnostic commit exposes the errno
but leaves the runtime unchanged. Possible direction: add a fail-closed fallback that marks
every non-allowlisted descriptor `CLOEXEC` when this flag is unavailable, then cover the
`EINVAL` path in the fast and integration gates.

**[P2] Keep the viewport test independent of `TERM`**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/src/approval/slice_tests.rs:807` searches for a box border,
but the production renderer legitimately selects plain output when `TERM=dumb`. The exact
test fails at line 808 with `TERM=dumb` and passes with `TERM=xterm-256color`, so the default
test result depends on the host environment. Please assert the width contract in both modes,
or inject a fixed renderer without mutating process-global environment.

**[P2] Preserve the package's default runnable binary**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/Cargo.toml:16` adds a second binary without `default-run`.
The documented `cargo run --package cosh-shell -- raw ...` commands now fail before launch
because Cargo cannot choose between `cosh-shell` and `cosh-ui-worker`. Please restore
`default-run = "cosh-shell"`, with a regression that exercises the documented command shape.

**[P2] Localize the complete Chinese approval card**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/src/ui/approval_surface.rs:71` localizes only action labels.
A Chinese card still renders `Approval`, `risk`, `Risk:`, and the irrecoverable warning in
English, even though the existing i18n catalog provides these concepts. Please project every
static label through the selected language and add a render-level Chinese assertion.

Review baseline: `69ae39dc5b97e47a399ed6c42d841d421e29c6dd...4f4ddadc96805ce888af49590f618dc46ee7fc40`

**[P1] Retire a live slice when its eligibility changes**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/src/approval/slice_present.rs:268` returns `false` when a
second approval makes the displayed request ineligible. The caller then sees the same
`active_panel_id` and returns without withdrawing the live worker surface. Meanwhile
`pending_card_capture` recomputes the first request as `TurnConsentHighRisk`. The old card
still shows Approve/Deny/Details, but right-arrow selects index 1 as ApproveTurn, so Enter can
approve the turn while the screen says Deny. Possible direction: retire and invalidate any
live slice before falling back, and add a regression that appends a second same-run approval
after the first worker card is visible and verifies the rendered and captured action sets.

**[P2] Make the raw-CLI target self-contained on a clean build**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/tests/raw_cli/ui_approval_slice.rs:15` assumes an un-hashed
`target/debug/cosh-core` already exists. From a clean target,
`cargo test --locked -p cosh-shell --test raw_cli ui_approval_slice` fails 18 of 19 tests;
after `cargo build --locked -p cosh-core`, the same 19 tests pass. This makes the documented
targeted test command depend on an unrelated prior build and lets CI job order mask failures.
Please provision the real Core artifact in the test gate (or otherwise declare the prerequisite)
and cover the suite from a clean target directory.

Review baseline: `69ae39dc5b97e47a399ed6c42d841d421e29c6dd...72ebe4a9faa661ed92a9a509e3e4ad4235bbec79`

**[P2] Revalidate a live worker card before reusing it**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/src/approval/slice_present.rs:250` returns early based only on
the request id and live surface, before rerunning eligibility. If a second same-run approval is
appended after the first worker card is visible, the action set becomes `TurnConsentHighRisk`
and the slice is no longer eligible, but this render pass keeps the old three-action,
single-request card. The new input remap prevents submitting the wrong action, but the screen
still omits the queue and `ApproveTurn` until a key causes a forced repaint. Possible direction:
check eligibility/action identity before this early return, retire the worker on a change, and
add a lifecycle regression that appends the second request after the worker surface is live.

**[P2] Make the raw-CLI target provision its real Core binary**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/tests/raw_cli/ui_approval_slice.rs:15` requires an un-hashed
`target/debug/cosh-core`, but the documented `cargo test -p cosh-shell --test raw_cli ...`
command does not build that separate package. From a clean target, the exact
`ui_approval_slice::eligible_approval_spawns_worker_process` test still fails immediately with
`real cosh-core must be built`; the rest of this new suite has the same prerequisite. This
keeps targeted runs and the integration gate dependent on prior build order. Please provision
the Core artifact in the gate or test harness, and cover this suite from a clean target.

Review baseline: `69ae39dc5b97...c855492963b2`

**[P2] Do not scroll a clean viewport when worker startup fails**

`src/cosh-ng/crates/cosh-shell/src/approval/slice_present.rs:149` now emits a full-viewport
scrollout whenever no session exists. With valid activation and an unavailable or unexecutable
worker, `start_tty` fails before acquiring or painting a surface, but this fallback still pushes
all visible shell output into scrollback before drawing the inline card. That turns the supported
"worker unavailable, stay inline" path into an unexpected screen clear. Possible direction:
track whether the failed publication actually dirtied or owned the terminal separately from
`geometry_required`, and add a startup-failure regression that asserts no viewport-scroll bytes
are emitted while the inline card remains visible.

- Format, layout, and Clippy passed for both shell binaries.
- 23 slice, 5 surface-session, and 1 committed-handoff regression tests passed.
